description: A server-agnostic email provider: sends via SMTP an' reads confirmations via IMAP against ANY server the operator configures (host, port, TLS). Use it fer self-hosted / on-premises mail, or any provider without a dedicated plugin. No server be hardcoded — the SMTP/IMAP host an' port come from the stored account settings. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects fer hidden recipients an' enforces the recipient at send time.
